blocks.t: simple way of living – control what you can and accept what you can't.  $ \underline{\text{This is not as easy as it sounds and will require considerable practice}} $ – it can take a lifetime to master. The Stoics also believed the most important foundation for a good and happy life is not money, fame, power or pleasure, but having a disciplined and principled character – something which seems to resonate with many people today.
